The image shows a single, somewhat ambiguous vertical pole that lacks the clear dual-tube construction of a real bassoon. The 'Bocal' checkpoint is also questionable; while a curved metal piece exists, its connection to the wood is blurry and lacks the precise mechanical fit of a real bocal socket. The Router correctly identified the internal bore as untestable.
